ai_overview:
Use this ready-to-copy wedding guest list template in Google Sheets or Excel by listing **one row per guest** and grouping families with a Household column.

### Ready-to-Use Columns
| Guest Name | Household / Party | Side / Group | Tier (A/B) | Contact (Email / Phone / Address) | Invite Sent | RSVP Status | Meal / Dietary | Table # | Gift & Thank-You |

### Quick Setup Tips
- Track one person per row: Keep individual RSVPs, meal choices, and seating clear while using a Household ID to group couples and families.
- Plan for declines: Wedding planners typically estimate 20% to 30% of invited guests will decline, so use A/B tiers if you need backup invites.
- Add formulas and dropdowns: Use `COUNTIF` and `SUM` to tally headcounts automatically, and add dropdowns for RSVP and invite statuses.
Sources named: Bliss & Bone, The Knot, Hitched, Reddit.
